content.title: About
content.content: Decaf latte coffee is a beverage made from decaffeinated espresso mixed with hot milk and topped with a light layer of milk foam. It retains the characteristic aroma and flavor of coffee while lacking the stimulating effect of caffeine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water‑process or supercritical CO₂, preserving most of the coffee’s aromatic compounds.
Decaf latte is often offered in cafés as a caffeine‑free alternative to regular latte.
The milk foam creates a smooth texture and helps release the drink’s aroma.
In some countries, decaf latte is considered a healthier option for people with high blood pressure.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Even without caffeine, coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Gentle on digestion
items.content: Caffeine can irritate the stomach, so decaf latte is often easier on sensitive digestive systems.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: The milk in latte provides calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee supplies small amounts of B2 and B3 vitamins, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Latte contains dairy, which can trigger allergic reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: If sweetened, the drink’s calorie count rises and it may affect blood sugar levels.

items.title: Residual caffeine
items.content: Decaffeinated coffee may still contain trace amounts of caffeine (typically up to 0.1 %).

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve decaf latte hot, often with flavored syrups, a sprinkle of cinnamon, or cocoa powder. Plant‑based milk alternatives (almond, oat) can be used for a vegan version.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry decaf coffee beans or grounds in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Prepared latte should be consumed within 2‑3 hours, otherwise the foam will lose its texture.
